all_inclusive_pricing.quote: Pricing provided shall include any and all labor; materials; equipment; supervision; travel and expenses; inflation/increases; and insurance to provide the services as described in the RFP.

buyer_form.quote: Proposer shall submit a Cost File for the entire duration of a one (1) year contract term with an option to extend for two (2) additional one (1) year terms.

asks.quote: Monthly Fee for Social Media Management and Content Services
Event or Special Project Fee (if applicable)
Hourly Rate for Additional Services (if applicable)

Consultant's bills shall include the name of the person who performed the Work, a brief description of the Services performed and/or the specific task in the Scope of Services to which it relates, the date the Services were performed, the number of hours spent on all Work billed on an hourly basis, and a description of any reimbursable expenditures.
The proposed pricing shall remain unchanged for the duration of the contract term, including any renewal terms.
City shall pay Consultant no later than thirty (30) calendar days after approval of the monthly invoice by City staff.

priced_scope.item: Social media strategy, planning and editorial calendars
Content development, copywriting and platform-specific messaging
Graphic design, photography, video and short-form multimedia content
Public information, educational, promotional, recruitment and community engagement content
Campaigns supporting City, NBPD and/or NBFD programs, projects, events and initiatives
Event coverage, interviews and original content production
Community management, comment monitoring and social listening
Identification of emerging issues, trends and content opportunities
Paid social media strategy, creative development and campaign support
Accessibility support, including captions, alternative text and accessible graphics
Performance measurement, analytics, reporting and recommendations
Quick-turn and after-hours support for urgent or time-sensitive communications
Other related social media and digital content services as requested by the City, NBPD or NBFD

multi_department.quote: Prospective proposers may elect to propose on Social Media Management, Strategy and Content Creation for the City of Newport Beach, Newport Beach Police Department (“NBPD”) and/or Newport Beach Fire Department (“NBFD”).

cost_primary_factor.quote: Since this solicitation is an RFP as opposed to a bid, pricing alone will not constitute the entire selection criteria.
